content: The Family of the Seal, the Amir ʿAlī and his sons, possessed a transcript called jafr that remains, and it shows how to derive the meaning in its full perfection. Ibn Turka says the splitting of the moon, in the wording of the verse (The Hour has drawn nigh: the moon is split), is the demonstration of that path of jafr as known to them and their servants; he gives letter-sums for the two phrases (printed as 92 and 283 in the text as read) and declines further discussion.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
